#include <iostream>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

static unordered_map<string, bool> memo;

bool solve(long long w, long long m);

bool trySolve(long long w, long long m) {
    return m % w == 0 && solve(w, m / w);
}

bool solve(long long w, long long m) {
    if (w <= 3 || m == 1) {
        return true;
    }
    string key = to_string(w) + "," + to_string(m);
    auto it = memo.find(key);
    if (it != memo.end()) {
        return it->second;
    }
    bool result = trySolve(w, m - 1) || trySolve(w, m) || trySolve(w, m + 1);
    memo[key] = result;
    return result;
}

int main() {
    long long w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    cout << (solve(w, m) ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;
    return 0;
}
